provider_approval_type: approved by the Office of the Attorney General (OAG)
applicable_to: employees at commercial lodging establishments with 10 or more rooms
required_topics: Identifying red flags of human trafficking
Reporting procedures for suspected human trafficking incidents
Understanding the importance of confidentiality and non-disciplinary actions against employees who report trafficking
recordkeeping_requirements: retain copies of completed certificates for at least three years and make them available for review by OAG, local, state, and federal law enforcement
certificate_requirements: approved training providers must provide a certificate of completion to each employee who completes the training
harbor_alliance_actions: Ensure compliance with the annual training requirement through approved providers
risks_or_constraints: Lodging establishments must ensure they have a means to report human trafficking incidents and maintain appropriate recordkeeping
